# London BS Ltd

> NICEIC registered electrician based in Dunstable. EICR reports, consumer unit upgrades, house rewires, fault finding and air conditioning installation across Dunstable, Luton, Milton Keynes, Leighton Buzzard and Houghton Regis. Selected London projects by arrangement.

Phone: 07427 670610
Email: londonbsltd@yahoo.com
Address: 10 Meadway, Dunstable, LU6 3JU
Managing Director: Lukasz Gryko

## Services

- [Electrical services](https://londonbs.uk/electrical-services): Overview of all services
- [EICR reports](https://londonbs.uk/eicr): Electrical Installation Condition Reports
- [Landlord EICR](https://londonbs.uk/landlord-eicr): Electrical safety inspections for private landlords
- [Consumer unit upgrades](https://londonbs.uk/consumer-unit-upgrades): Fuse board and consumer unit replacement
- [House rewires](https://londonbs.uk/rewires): Full and partial rewires
- [Fault finding](https://londonbs.uk/fault-finding): Tracing and repairing electrical faults
- [Emergency electrician](https://londonbs.uk/emergency-electrician): Urgent electrical work
- [Air conditioning installation](https://londonbs.uk/air-conditioning-installation): Split system installation by a F-Gas registered engineer
